'''Ermin Phin-Mar''' was an [[Scout/Legends|explorer]] and [[Archaeologist/Legends|archaeologist]] who discovered [[The Oracle (Pelgrin)|the Oracle]] at [[Pelgrin]] three thousand [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before the [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|Battle of Naboo]].
